source: Owner direct chat after discussing hitscan, projectile flight and time control
owner_message_original: игрок двигается как обычно, а все остальное замедляется, во время останвоки так же, наши пули могут так же ранить и нас. Просто нужно заложиться на это при проектировании системы попаданий. А так начнем задачу давай
owner_message_english_translation: The player moves normally while everything else slows down; the same applies during a stop. Our bullets can also injure us. Just account for this when designing the hit system. Let's start the task.
decision: Authorize MSQ-68 implementation with finite-flight bullets designed for world slowdown and complete stop, normal player movement, and self-hit eligibility.
implementation_authorized: MSQ-68 / CombatFoundation01 only; complete focused implementation, review, corrections and local task closure commit.

fixed_rules.player_movement: Remains normal while the rest of the world slows or stops.
fixed_rules.bullets: All bullets, including player-fired bullets, follow world simulation time and can remain suspended at zero world time.
fixed_rules.self_damage: A player's own bullets can injure that player. Shooter attribution must not imply permanent collision or damage immunity.
fixed_rules.foundation: Use finite-flight simulation and collision-time damage rather than immediate hitscan damage decorated by delayed visuals. Preserve a separate time-policy seam for the later ability.

controller_design_implications: Sweep projectile travel to avoid tunneling; use gameplay coordinates independent of first-person rendering scale.
Keep moving-player contact with stationary bullets detectable. Define bounded geometric launch clearance without permanent owner exclusion.
Distinguish simulation aging from real-time safety limits and bound active bullet/effect counts without silently restoring ammunition or moving stopped bullets.
Verify the projectile clock seam at normal, reduced and exactly zero scale without implementing the player-facing time ability in MSQ-68.
later_tasks: PlayerSurvival01 connects self-hit events to player health; TimeSlow01 implements coherent world slowdown/stop with normal player movement. Input, cost, duration and detailed non-movement action timing remain prototype design choices to document.
preservation: PurchasedArms06 baseline, retained lobby and owner edits remain preserved. No new art, architecture, purchases, enemy implementation, player health UI or time-ability production is added to MSQ-68.
